property_summary: After initialization, reference reverts SetMinSum(1) so MinSum stays at default 0; bug accepts it setting MinSum=1. Then a zero-value Collect(0) succeeds in reference (balance >= MinSum) and reverts in bug (balance < MinSum), causing the revert boolean to differ.
change_summary: Delete the if statement that reverts when intitalized is true, so SetMinSum can be called even after initialization.
